name: 楊元森
objective: Fundamental theory of statically indeterminate structures; analysis of indeterminate beams, frames, and trusses by stiffness and flexibility methods; study of influence lines for beams, frames, and trusses.
課程進度(1-16週):
Week 1: Statically Indeterminate Structures (SIS) 
Week 2: Principle of Work, Energy for SIS (class time to move to week 3 or 4, to be scheduled in week 1) 
Week 3: Method of Virtual Work for Trusses of SIS
Week 4: Method of Virtual Work for Beams and Frames of SIS
Week 5: Method of Virtual Work for Thermal and Settlement Problems
Week 6: Force Method and Compatibility of Displacements
Week 7: Statically Indeterminate Structures with Thermal and Settlement Problems
Week 8: Midterm
Week 9: Force Method on Statically Indeterminate Structures (5): Symmetric Structures
Week 10: Force Method on Statically Indeterminate Structures (5): Influence Lines
Week 11: Force Method on Statically Indeterminate Structures (5): Influence Lines
Week 12: Slope-deflection Method 1
Week 13: Slope-deflection Method 2
Week 14: Displacement Method: Moment-Distribution 1
Week 15: Displacement Method: Moment-Distribution 2
Week 16: Final Examination
Week 17: Advanced exercises 1 online
Week 18: Advanced exercises 2 online
